name: Rising Blood Magic
text: The power within your blood grows. You gain the Basic Spellcasting Feat benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the bloodrager archetype, add a common spell of the appropriate tradition and rank to your repertoire. In addition, when you Cast a Spell from your repertoire and you are at least Drained 1, increase the extra damage dealt by that spell from Rage by 1.
